Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly determined the release date of "Ulti Ganga" as 2016 in its final analysis, despite the WebSurfer agent explicitly providing multiple sources (IMDb, Wikipedia, PakMag) confirming the film was released in 1942. This error represents a failure to cross-verify and synthesize the gathered data, leading to a false conclusion that "I Am Breathing" (2013) came out earlier than "Ulti Ganga" (incorrectly cited as 2016), when in reality "Ulti Ganga" (1942) came out much earlier.
